## About Me

Hi, my name is Harika and I am a junior majoring in Chemistry! I am currently
working on a tool that identifies by-catch in protist transcriptomes (sequences from organisms other than the intended target).
My project explores whether this by-catch reflects contamination or potential biological relationships between species.


Here you'll find information about my research, outreach and education activities, and my comprehensive lab notebook documenting ongoing projects and findings.
